exercises.title: Customer 1 — stakeholder, customer or user?
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers Figure 2-1: users are a subset of customers, and customers are a subset of stakeholders. A customer derives direct or indirect benefit from the product (requests, pays for, selects, specifies, uses or receives its output). Direct users operate the product; indirect users receive its outputs without touching it. Some stakeholders are not customers at all. Place each party of a hospital pharmacy system in its smallest set.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Hình 2-1: người dùng ⊂ khách hàng ⊂ bên liên quan. Người dùng trực tiếp thao tác sản phẩm; người dùng gián tiếp nhận đầu ra mà không chạm vào nó. Xếp mỗi bên vào tập nhỏ nhất của nó.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Customer 1 — stakeholder, customer or user? — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Direct user
   - r1.k: Indirect user
   - r2.k: Customer (not a user)
   - r3.k: Stakeholder (not a customer)
   - r4.k: Direct user
   - r5.k: Stakeholder (not a customer)
   - r6.k: Customer (not a user)
   Users supply user requirements; customers such as sponsors supply business requirements; other stakeholders bring constraints (regulations, contracts) but do not benefit from the product directly.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Users supply user requirements; customers such as sponsors supply business requirements; other stakeholders bring constraints (regulations, contracts) but do not benefit from the product directly.

bang.de:

o.s: Pharmacist who dispenses medicines with the system
Head of pharmacy who only reads the weekly stock report e-mailed to her
Hospital director who sponsors and pays for the project
External auditor who checks compliance with drug regulations
Nurse who records doses given on the ward tablet
Medicine supplier whose delivery schedule is affected
Procurement officer who selects the software vendor

bang.giaiThich: Users supply user requirements; customers such as sponsors supply business requirements; other stakeholders bring constraints (regulations, contracts) but do not benefit from the product directly.

exercises.title: Customer 2 — the expectation gap
exercises.problemHtml:
The expectation gap: what the customer expects and what the team delivers diverge because needs were never fully shared or understood. Every practice of Chapter 2 exists to close it — through participation, clear communication and explicit agreement, not mind-reading.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

Khoảng cách kỳ vọng: điều khách mong đợi và điều đội giao lệch nhau vì nhu cầu chưa từng được chia sẻ/hiểu đầy đủ.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Customer 2 — the expectation gap — answer key

1. What closes the expectation gap best?Điều gì thu hẹp khoảng cách kỳ vọng tốt nhất?
   Answer: c) Frequent customer participation and explicit agreement on requirements
   Participation + communication + agreement.VI: Tham gia + giao tiếp + thống nhất.

2. Who typically provides the business requirements?Ai thường cung cấp yêu cầu nghiệp vụ?
   Answer: a) Customers such as the executive sponsor
   Sponsors set the framework; users fill in the user requirements.VI: Nhà tài trợ đặt khung; người dùng bổ sung yêu cầu người dùng.

3. A manager offers to describe what the clerks need so you don’t "waste their time". Best response?Một quản lý đề nghị tự mô tả nhu cầu của nhân viên để "khỏi phí thời gian của họ". Trả lời tốt nhất?
   Answer: b) Thank them, and still talk to the real clerks — managers rarely know the details of the daily tasks
   Reach the real users.VI: Tiếp cận người dùng thật.

exercises.title: Customer 3 — which kind of requirement does each party supply?
exercises.problemHtml:
Different parties supply different levels of requirements: sponsors and other customers set business requirements; users describe user requirements (tasks, outputs, quality expectations); regulators, legal staff and other non-customer stakeholders impose constraints and business rules.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:

  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Customer 4 — direct and indirect users
exercises.problemHtml:
Direct users operate the product hands-on; indirect users receive its outputs (reports, notifications, labels) without touching it. Both are users with needs: what an indirect user needs from the output is a user requirement too.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Người dùng trực tiếp và gián tiếp đều có nhu cầu cần khai thác.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Customer 4 — direct and indirect users — answer key

1. A warehouse manager never logs in but receives a daily activity report by e-mail. She is…Quản lý kho không đăng nhập nhưng nhận báo cáo hằng ngày qua e-mail. Cô ấy là…
   Answer: a) an indirect user whose needs for the report must be elicited
   Indirect users depend on outputs.VI: Người dùng gián tiếp phụ thuộc vào đầu ra.

2. What can users usually describe well?Người dùng thường mô tả tốt điều gì?
   Answer: a) Their tasks, the outputs they need, and the quality characteristics they expect
   Ask users about tasks, not designs.VI: Hỏi người dùng về công việc, không về thiết kế.
